column3: web/src/views/dashboard.ts renders the period widget set from GET /api/v1/staff/dashboard/widgets (revenue per currency, active and new customers, open tickets, overdue invoices), the exception queue and Latest invoices, but there is no revenue chart, no previous-period trend, and support is a count rather than a table.

internal/settings/settings.go declares 72 keys in 16 groups served by GET and PUT /api/v1/staff/settings and rendered group-by-group at /settings/system in web/src/views/system-settings.ts with write-only secrets and one transaction per group, which is stronger than Paymenter's 11 groups.

web/src/views/catalog-admin.ts and catalog-admin-product.ts create, edit and hide products and delete categories and servers, but DELETE /api/v1/staff/catalog/products/{id} (catalog.DeleteProductTx) is served with no screen, the editor offering only Hide from the storefront.

web/src/views/catalog-admin-product.ts edits plans with billing interval, anchor day, setup fee and plan order, and Duplicate posts /api/v1/staff/catalog/products/{id}/duplicate to copy prices and options, so the price editor and duplicate are both closed.

web/src/views/coupons.ts creates and edits coupons with a product picker and reads redemptions per row, and Retire sets enabled false through PUT /api/v1/staff/coupons/{id} because a coupon referenced by an invoice is never deleted.

web/src/views/config-options.ts creates, edits and deletes options and their per-price-version amounts through /api/v1/staff/config-options, /api/v1/staff/config-options/{id} and /api/v1/staff/config-options/{id}/prices.

web/src/views/tax-rates.ts creates dated rates, closes them and deletes only a rate that never took effect, and drives tax-import source, preview and import, but the run history at GET /api/v1/staff/tax-import/runs still has no screen.

web/src/views/currencies.ts creates, edits, disables and promotes a default currency through POST /api/v1/staff/currencies and PUT /api/v1/staff/currencies/{code}, showing the server's own formatted example for every row.

web/src/views/service-properties.ts creates, edits, reorders and deletes property definitions through /api/v1/staff/service-properties and /service-properties/{key} and /reorder, with the customer_visible and show_on_invoice flags.
web/src/views/gateways.ts saves the gateway configuration through PUT /api/v1/staff/gateways with write-only secrets and tests the saved configuration at GET /api/v1/staff/gateways/test.

web/src/views/servers.ts creates, edits and deletes provisioning servers through /api/v1/staff/servers and tests the saved configuration at GET /api/v1/staff/servers/test, rendering the plans the adapter advertises.

web/src/views/marketplace.ts lists installed extensions and installs from the index with a digest pin and refresh, but there is no enable/disable, no zip upload, no scaffold and no upgrade of an installed extension, because loading is by environment variable only.

web/src/views/roles.ts edits custom roles against the served catalogue at GET /api/v1/staff/permissions and PUT /api/v1/staff/roles/{id}/permissions and shows the four compiled-in system roles read-only in internal/authn/authz.go, which is the permission matrix.

web/src/views/api-keys.ts creates, lists, revokes and CIDR-allowlists keys, but every read is scoped to the caller (ListAPIKeys(user.ID) in internal/httpapi/apikeys.go) so there is no administrator view of another user's keys.
web/src/views/oauth-clients.ts lists, creates, rotates and deletes OAuth2 clients through /api/v1/staff/oauth-clients and edits social providers as rows on the same screen.

web/src/views/notification-templates.ts is a master-detail editor over /api/v1/staff/notification-templates/{event_key} with a server-rendered preview, a served placeholder vocabulary and a reset action.
The Email tab of web/src/views/logs.ts reads GET /api/v1/staff/logs/email with status, kind and recipient filters over the durable outbox, so a delivery and its last_error are both visible.

web/src/views/operations.ts lists service_operations read-only and web/src/views/automation.ts lists jobs with the worker heartbeat, but no screen and no route in internal/httpapi offers a manual retry, a delete or a mark-resolved.
The Errors tab of web/src/views/logs.ts reads GET /api/v1/staff/logs/errors with level and source filters.
The HTTP tab of web/src/views/logs.ts reads GET /api/v1/staff/logs/http with status, min_status and path filters.

web/src/views/audit.ts reads the append-only GET /api/v1/staff/audit with filters and a redacted changes diff, and web/src/views/approvals.ts adds the second-signature queue, so this is stronger than Paymenter's viewer.

web/src/views/automation.ts shows the registered job list and GET /api/v1/staff/cron/heartbeat, but the per-run history served by GET /api/v1/staff/cron from cron_runs in internal/httpapi/cron.go has no screen.

web/src/views/updates.ts checks the update server, records an approval and previews the telemetry payload through /api/v1/staff/updates, but it cannot install a version and offers no extension upgrade because apply.steps is a deploy procedure shown as text.

web/src/views/payments.ts lists payments, web/src/views/refund.ts refunds one through POST /api/v1/staff/payments/{id}/refunds and web/src/views/invoice.ts records an offline payment through POST /api/v1/staff/invoices/{id}/payments, but a payment has no edit or delete because the row is immutable.

Credit notes are issued from web/src/views/invoice.ts (POST /api/v1/staff/invoices/{id}/credit-notes) and download at /api/v1/staff/credit-notes/{id}/pdf, and web/src/views/credits.ts posts grants and debits, but no adjustment note can be voided.

web/src/views/cancellations.ts is the queue over GET /api/v1/staff/cancellations with execute and reject (reason required) and a staff-initiated request at POST /api/v1/staff/services/{id}/cancellation.

web/src/views/ticket.ts and tickets.ts reply, close, assign, update, attach and set custom fields through /api/v1/staff/tickets/{id}/replies, /close, /assign and /fields, with GET /api/v1/staff/tickets/meta driving the form.

web/src/views/customer.ts has Overview (services, subscriptions, balance, portal access, holds), Invoices, Billing details and Activity tabs, but no tickets tab, no credits tab and no billing-agreement tab, since payment methods are portal-only and internal/payments/agreements.go has no staff route.

web/src/views/users.ts creates a login with a role, a verified address and its billing account in one act and edits, disables, deletes and sets a password, with last_administrator and self_lockout enforced server-side and the 2FA reset on the customer screen.

web/src/views/customer.ts posts /api/v1/staff/users/{id}/impersonate and web/src/ui/layout.ts renders a non-dismissible banner rebuilt from /api/v1/auth/me, while internal/httpapi/auth.go refuses money and credential routes during an impersonation.

web/src/views/invoice-new.ts has the line repeater with a product picker, customer search and a draft-or-issue choice and the PDF downloads from /api/v1/staff/invoices/{id}/pdf afterwards, but there is no send-email toggle and no PDF at creation.
web/src/views/order-new.ts posts /api/v1/staff/orders with a customer picker, a price-version picker, quantity and deep links to the created order.
The New service dialog in web/src/views/services.ts posts /api/v1/staff/services with customer and product pickers, config options, a required reason and a comped path that creates no subscription.

web/src/views/credits.ts grants credit through POST /api/v1/staff/customers/{id}/credit, which issues a numbered credit note with a required reason and reads the note, its audit row and the new balance back.

No screen offers multi-select (web/src/ui/table.ts has no selection column) and bulk delete stays absent by design on immutable invoices, journal rows, audit rows and credit notes, the many-record need being met by the CSV exports at /api/v1/staff/exports/invoices.csv, customers.csv and services.csv.

web/src/ui/layout.ts groups staff navigation into Overview, Revenue, People, Operations, Support, Configuration, Integrations, Platform and Trust, each entry filtered by both its permission and hasRoute.

Related-page grouping exists as the Integrations rail group (gateways, servers, marketplace) and as the Related, Holds and Operations cards on /services/:id plus the payments and credit-notes sections on /invoices/:id, but there is no cluster abstraction or cluster landing page.
